It’s the season 🎄✨ Join us at both locations, festively decorated and ready to be your perfect place to drink & be merry at Treadwell Park.
We may not see each other often or even stay in contact often but when we are all together it’s like no time has past.

I swung by @treadwellpark and quickly realized it’s one of those places you can pull up to any time of year, but it feels extra cozy right now with the holiday spirit. ✨🎄.
Both the Downtown and Uptown spots have this easy, come-as-you-are vibe that makes hanging out feel fun. 🍻😌.
Big bar, roomy tables, and a crowd that’s there to actually enjoy themselves without making it a whole thing. 🪩🙌. Bring friends or go solo, either way you settle in fast. 🤗🧥.The food hit the spot too. 🥗🔥.
From their classic wings, to their Giant Soft Pretzel, with all the dips, the place is basically the table-share that everyone enjoys 🥨✔️.
And if you’re into sandwiches, the “Sweet & Spicy” Crispy Chicken Sandwich is one of those things you order once and automatically plan to order again. 🍗🔥.But if what you want is a drink, tear no more, there are over 20 beers on tap, plus cider, wine, and cocktails if you want to mix it up. 🍺🍷🍹.
Screens for games (and special nights like @dancingwiththestars watching parties), ping-pong, pinball, or you can just hang and keep things low-key. 🏓🎯.
It’s the kind of spot that works for whatever mood you’re in. 🎁❄️.If it’s been on your radar (Or this is the first time you heard about it), consider this your sign to go. 🦄🌈 #AColoROYMoment
